definitions.short: Baruk , the name of three Israelites
definitions.full: H1263. Baruk בָּרוּךְ proper name, masculine ( blessed ) 1 friend and amanuensis of Jeremiah Jer 32:12-13 , 16 ; 36:4-32 ; 43:3 , 6 ; 45:1-2 ,. 2 a priest, son of Zabbai (Zaccai) Neh 3:20 ; 10:7 . 3 son of Colhozeh, of the tribe of Judah Neh 11:5 .
